title: Noether R363-R364 Papers 15-16 source-fix/audit survival no-patch support
scope: R363 covers Paper 15 printed/source pp. 138-156. R364 covers Paper 16 printed pp. 25-30, including the Berichtigungen block and ending immediately before the Paper 17 boundary comment.
summary: R363 applies no TeX patch and records that current R347 Paper 15 is normalized-identical to the R335/R334 accepted Paper 15 source-fix survival span, preserving the R303-R307 source-fix chain and later no-fix/revert traps. R364 applies no TeX patch and records that current R347 Paper 16 is normalized-identical to the R343/R341 Paper 16 source-audit survival span, preserving formulae [1]-[10], Berichtigungen, accepted-date ending, and corrected source routing.
caveats: No TeX patch is made by R363 or R364.
R363 is current-base survival only and does not freshly recertify Paper 15; best staged P15 source is about GDZ/native400, with derived 650/1000 readability crops in prior packages.
R364 is current-base survival only and does not freshly recertify Paper 16; best staged P16 witnesses are about 400ppi, with enlarged formula crops only as readability aids.
Do not import stale Web R275 or old P15 ledger rows over R347.
Do not use bad-offset GDZ canvases 25-30 for Paper 16.
This wave is current-base survival/anti-regression support only, not Noether closure, not multilingual synchronization, not strict native650/1000 source closure, and not critical-edition material.
